title: ProtocolEnvelope
description: Common envelope for all protocol messages (v0.x)
comment: payload is optional - specific message schemas should require it if needed

id.description: Unique message identifier for correlation and tracing

correlationId.description: Optional ID used to correlate request/response pairs

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp indicating when the message was created

meta.description: Optional metadata not relevant to protocol semantics
